summary: Attempt 2 redesign completed. RawVerifierResult now binds proving evidence explicitly to individual observations and obligations, while native artifacts remain envelope-level provenance. Normalized evidence preserves each exact observation/evidence binding and binds the invocation, verifier binding, checkpoint, raw-result digest, subject, supplied collection-time disposition, and native provenance.

verification.evidence: 46 tests passed, covering two-obligation attribution, multiple evidence kinds, provenance separation, lineage binding, time dispositions, missing/duplicate/unrelated evidence, inconclusive Gate behavior, input guards, checkpoints, module contracts, and schema enforcement.
The revised semantic validator passed Node.js syntax checking.
No whitespace or patch-format errors were reported in the authorized files.

residualRisks: Attempt 2 remains a proposal requiring independent parent WorkItemVerification.
Adapters, normalization runtime, checkpoint persistence, policy execution, Gate promotion, and traceability contributors remain outside this work item.
integrationNotes: The ambiguous global proving-evidence list was removed from RawVerifierResult.

Pass observations require every evidence kind declared by their obligation; fail observations require explicit proving evidence; inconclusive observations may explicitly lack proof but cannot satisfy a verified policy or Gate candidate.
Normalization requires exactly one item per explicit observation/evidence binding and rejects cross-attribution, omissions, duplicates, substitutions, and unrelated evidence kinds.
Collection time is supplied through a closed timestamp or not-applicable tagged union and is never generated by normalization.
The module remains provider-neutral with a proposer-only verifier port and no policy, Gate, graph, integration, or workflow-progression authority.
